## Akari Sauna · Waitlist Automation v1
Built from *Waitlist Automation_1.0* (Eraser) + 24 Sep client clarifications.

**Before activating:** edit the **Config** node, attach the two Header Auth credentials (Airtable PAT, SendGrid key) to every HTTP node, and keep `sandboxMode: true` until testing is signed off.

**Lanes:** 1 Intake (Typeform) · 2 Engine (hourly: timeouts, invites, heads-ups) · 3 Candidate response (GET view → POST commit) · 4 Send Now (Airtable button) · 5 Daily report · Executor (writes Airtable, sends email, logs).

Every trigger is tagged with a **route**, passes through **Config**, and is routed by the **Route** switch.

### 1 · Intake
Typeform webhook → one Airtable row per location × membership chosen. Skips queues the person is already on. Typeform only gets its 200 once rows are saved — a failure shows as a failed delivery in Typeform and triggers the error alert, instead of being silently lost.

### 2 · Engine (hourly)
Expires 24h holds (1st miss → Warm, 2nd → No Reply) around the clock. From 08:00–20:00 it fills each queue's gap (Minimum − Active − pending signups − open holds) and sends the next ~10 an early heads-up.

### 3 · Candidate response
Email buttons open a **confirmation page** (GET). Only the button on that page (POST) changes anything, so email link scanners can't accept or decline for someone.
Yes → Signed Up + signup link · Tour → spot held, team alerted · Not now / No → buckets · late reply → Warm.

### 4 · Send Now (staff override)
Airtable button → invite this person now, whatever their position or the queue count. The button URL carries the record ID and the secret key from Config.

### 6 · Send Sign-up Link (staff, usually after a tour)
Airtable button → email this person their private sign-up link and mark them Signed Up, as if they had pressed Sign up. Unlimited also takes them off their other waitlists. Same secret key as Send Now. Refuses if the queue has no Signup URL.

### 7 · Cal.com tour bookings
Cal.com webhook (booked / moved / cancelled) → writes **Tour At** on the waitlist row, matched by the row ID on the booking link, else by email. The engine releases the hold `tourReleaseHours` after the tour unless a sign-up link was sent. The webhook URL ends in `?k=` + `calWebhookSecret`.

### 5 · Daily report (07:30)
Invited · signed up · not now · no longer interested (with reasons), conversion by location, queue snapshot, items needing attention.

### Executor
Carries out every planned action in a safe order: **0)** swap in secure random response tokens → **1)** update Waitlist rows → **2)** write Activity Log → **3)** send emails. Writes go 10 rows per request, ≥500ms apart, to stay under Airtable's 5 requests/second limit. If Airtable still refuses a batch (it locks the base for 30s after a burst), only the refused batches wait 35s and are resent, up to 4 attempts, before the error alert fires. No email goes out until its rows are saved.
